summary: an entry that changes what code outside its modules calls states its interface — what changes, what it hides, the rejected alternative and why — optional, all three parts or refused
acceptance: an entry carrying an interface with all three parts parses, one missing a part is refused naming it, an entry with none parses, and the field's hint renders into the plan prompt through the same renderer as the package's other fields
tests: an interface missing one of its three parts is refused at parse
an entry whose interface carries all three parts parses
the plan prompt renders the interface field's hint
pins: an entry that declares no interface parses
notes: Whether an entry needs one is plan's judgment, which no gate re-decides — the schema checks only that a present field is complete. The three parts' spelling is build's call; the contract is that all three are there or the field is refused.
